families.mechanism: Windowed-CVD slope agrees with price momentum (cross form: joint condition turning true fires the entry)
families.signal: slope = CVD_L(t) - CVD_L(t-s); LONG iff slope > 0 and ROC_s(t) > 0; SHORT iff slope < 0 and ROC_s(t) < 0

families.mechanism: Donchian breakout gated by a volume-surge z-score (state form, families2 donchian convention)
families.signal: LONG iff C(t) > max(H(t-n..t-1)) and zV_m(t) >= z*; SHORT iff C(t) < min(L(t-n..t-1)) and zV_m(t) >= z*

families.mechanism: Exhaustion reversal: price extends to a new extreme while the CVD proxy fails to confirm its own recent extreme (proxy fixed to SV2, state form)
families.signal: SHORT iff H(t) > max(H(t-n..t-1)) and CVD_L(t) < max(CVD_L(t-n..t-1)); LONG iff L(t) < min(L(t-n..t-1)) and CVD_L(t) > min(CVD_L(t-n..t-1))

families.mechanism: Volume-climax rejection reversal: climax volume into a move, bar closes back through the midline against the move (state form)
families.signal: LONG iff ROC_s(t) < 0 and zV_m(t) >= z* and CLV(t) >= +0.5; SHORT iff ROC_s(t) > 0 and zV_m(t) >= z* and CLV(t) <= -0.5

features.CLV(t): (2C - H - L) / (H - L) if H > L else 0
features.CVD_L(t): rolling sum of SV over the L bars ending at t, full window required (windowed by construction; infinite-history CVD is not daemon-reproducible and is never used)
features.zV_m(t): (V(t) - rolling mean_m(V)) / rolling std_m(V), ddof=1, full window required; 0 when window std is 0
